body.text: The party we sent out from {param:town} was fallen on in the open. We have lost {param:lost} of them.
The rest go on, or so the man who brought the news believes. He did not stay to be certain and I do not blame him.
I write because you will hear of it, and because I sent them.

options.text: and have read it with care
and would rather not have needed it

steps.prompt: What the town should do now

options.label: see to your defences
options.text: See to your defences, then. I had rather pay for walls than for another letter like this one.

options.label: keep the people at home
options.text: Keep the people at home and make the town worth staying in.
